name: Nim
summary: Classic two-player impartial game where players remove matches from piles and the player taking the last match wins.
rules_text: Set up two or more piles with any number of objects in each pile. Players take turns. On a turn, choose exactly one non-empty pile and remove any positive number of objects from it, up to the entire pile. You may not remove from more than one pile per turn. Play continues alternately. The player who removes the very last object from the board wins. If there are no objects left at the start of your turn, you lose.
rating_reason: Specific turn-based removal game, pure strategy, fits engine.
